• Provide support with HR-related issues including onboarding new team members.
• Ensure the administrative interlink with the other  departments.

Can you make the difference?

The successful candidate will be an experienced professional who demonstrates the following experience and competencies:

• A minimum of 5 years of work experience, preferably as an assistant at senior management level
• Excellent written and oral communication skills
• Proficiency in IT, web management and social media skills
• Excellent level of English, written and spoken. Knowledge of other languages is an asset.
• Full proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
• Excellent time management and organisational skills with the ability to prioritise work accordingly
• Excellent interpersonal skills and customer orientation
• Understanding of underlying issues and proactively developing and evaluating solutions

DHL Aviation, DHL Express’s sorting center in Belgium, is the beating heart of package transport at the airport.The brand-new building is a showcase of automation and technology in the field of logistics. Shipments are delivered by truck or plane from all over the world, consolidated at Brucargo, and sorted for their final destinations. These shipments are then loaded onto trucks or planes again and transported to their final destinations.

Jobomschrijving

As a warehouse worker for DHL Aviation, you are trained to perform following tasks: loading and sorting of incoming and outgoing shipments by trucks and plains throughout the world. DHL has an excellent on-the-job training so you don’t need to have any relevant work experience: enthusiasm and willingness to learn are far more important.

• Your knowledge of English is very good (important for all work and safety related instructions on the job).
•  You have a basic knowledge of Dutch (level A1, your level will be put to the test).
• You can work full-time, 38hours a week.
• You can work from Monday through Friday on a weekly base in the shifts 7PM-3AM and 8PM-4AM.
• You are willing to improve your knowledge of Dutch (DHL offers Dutch learning sessions during the working hours).
• DHL Aviation is located on the following address: Vliegveld 117, 1820 Steenokkerzeel.
• You are able to get to work on your behalf
• You are looking forward to having an energetic job that requires you to walk a lot and lift heavy shipments ( /- 25 kg on a regular basis)
• Working safely comes first for you.
• You can work in accordance with internal quality processes and procedures, as well as legal requirements.

Sanofi heeft meer dan 110.000 medewerkers, is gevestigd in meer dan 100 landen en is daarmee één van de grootste farmaceutische ondernemingen ter wereld. Sanofi’s sterktes zijn diabetesoplossingen, vaccins, innovatieve geneesmiddelen, consumer health care, opkomende markten en diergeneesmiddelen.

Door de overname van Genzyme in 2011 heeft Sanofi  haar expertise op vlak van de biotechnologie en de behandeling van zeldzame ziektes versterkt . Vandaag geniet Sanofi Genzyme van het bereik en de middelen van een van 's werelds grootste farmaceutische bedrijven, met een gemeenschappelijk engagement om het leven van patiënten te verbeteren. De productiesite in Geel is een onderdeel van Sanofi’s Industrial Operations network en is het Center of Excellence voor de productie van therapeutische enzymen voor de behandeling van de ziekte van Pompe’s.

De productie van deze enzymen gebeurt via celculturen in grote bioreactoren, gevolgd door de opzuivering ervan. Op de site in Geel zetten zo’n 650 enthousiaste medewerkers zich elke dag ten volle in om dit complexe proces in goede banen te leiden.

Reference Samples

For an international manufacturing company in the Aalst region, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to work in a 2-shift system. You will help ensure the optimal operation of an advanced machinery and equipment park, while having the opportunity to further develop your technical skills.

You will work in a 2-shift system from 06:00 to 14:00 and from 14:00 to 22:00.

Your tasks and responsibilities

• As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving industrial machinery and technical installations. Thanks to your technical expertise, you will help keep production processes reliable and minimise downtime.
• Carrying out preventive maintenance on production machines, injection moulding machines and auxiliary equipment.
• Troubleshooting and resolving electrical, mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic faults.
• Carrying out corrective repairs in the event of technical failures.
• Analysing faults and identifying sustainable solutions.
• Independently carrying out small technical projects and improvements.
• Actively contributing to optimisations aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of the machinery.
• Working closely with the production department to minimise downtime.
• Working in accordance with applicable safety, quality and environmental standards.
• Contributing to a clean, safe and orderly working environment.

• You have a technical degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation or a similar technical field. Relevant practical experience can also be considered.
• You have experience in maintaining and repairing industrial machinery.
• You have knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance in a production environment.
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is an advantage. If you have limited experience in this area, you will have the opportunity to learn and develop your skills internally.
• Experience with injection moulding machines is an advantage, but not a requirement.
• You have a good command of Dutch.
• You are able to understand technical documentation in English and/or German.
• You have strong analytical skills and a solution-oriented approach.
• You have a hands-on mentality and a strong sense of responsibility.
• You enjoy working as part of a team, while also being able to carry out technical interventions independently.
